about: The song's editions, read by tools/sing_site.py (docs/HOME-PAGE.md, 'Editions'). The home page (now.itsby.you) offers the newest; /history offers every one, newest first. An edition is named by its audio id (the SHA-256 of its samples, in its record) and its bytes never change once released: the build checks file.sha256 and file.bytes. To add one, add it first in the list (newest first: the studio's build reads the first as the newest), with its released file kept (file.path) or its render (render.path, given the cover as it's served). One marked "held": true is left off the home page and the history (the studio's build still reads it) until it is released: then remove the mark.

editions.title: The first version
editions.note: The song as it began, shaped by the people who sang along to it online.
editions.command: uv run python tools/everyone.py --render renders/review/contest.flac --arrange motif=bridge lift=false ending=ring
